subject: POC kickoff — room access, AV checklist, and recording consent
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nebularetail.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kate Lin <kate.lin@nebularetail.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling POC kickoff — onsite or virtual?

Hi Irene & Dylan,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We’re excited to move into the hands-on POC phase and want to lock down a kickoff working session. High-level ask: a 4-hour working session that includes prompt review, routing decisions, and a short throughput/load test on a representative dataset.

A few constraints on our side: most engineers will be onsite in San Francisco the week of Aug 23 — they prefer an onsite or hybrid session that allows remote participation for our analytics team in NY. We also need to confirm visitor access (badging) and whether you can record the session for playback to folks who can’t attend.

Proposed windows: Aug 24 (Tue) 09:30–13:30 PT or Aug 25 (Wed) 13:00–17:00 PT. Can you confirm Redwood availability and whether you can provide an AV check and a load-test runbook?

Thanks — looking forward to firming this up.

Alex Rivera
Lead Data Engineer, Nebula Retail
alex.rivera@nebularetail.com
Attachments: none
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nebularetail.com>, Kate Lin <kate.lin@nebularetail.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling POC kickoff — onsite or virtual?

Hi Alex — great to hear, and both windows look workable. Quick confirmations and what we’ll bring: 

- We can support a hybrid session (onsite Redwood engineers + remote join link).
- We will run a focused throughput/load test during the last 60 minutes; Dev will prepare a short runbook with inputs/expected metrics.
- We are happy to record the session, but need written consent from Nebula for documentation retention — we’ll attach a one-page consent form to sign.
- For onsite: please provide the list of names for visitor badges at least 48 hours in advance.

Action items for us: I’ll tentatively hold Aug 24 09:30–13:30 PT on the Redwood calendar. Can you confirm final attendee list and whether you want us to bring a laptop for screen-sharing (we usually provide a dedicated machine for the load test)?

I’m copying Dylan (ops) and Dev (inference) so we can coordinate AV and the runbook.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: proposed_agenda_v1.docx (attached in next email)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nebularetail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling POC kickoff — onsite or virtual?

Irene / Alex — I checked conference room availability for our SF lab. We have Lab 2 (capacity 12, HDMI + USB-C + external mic) available Aug 24 09:00–14:00 PT — I’ll hold it pending final confirmation. A couple of notes for on-site logistics: 

- Visitor badges: security needs full name + company + email + phone; please send list by Fri, Aug 20 EOD.
- AV: I can run a 30-minute pre-check at 09:00 the day of (we can also do a quick remote check the day before).
- Recording: our standard is to host the recording on a restricted Drive folder; we’ll include access to Nebula emails only. If Nebula requires local downloads or third-party hosting, we’ll need explicit approval.

Irene — I’ll attach the room layout and AV checklist in a follow-up (room_layout.pdf, AV_checklist.xlsx).

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Field Ops | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com

Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 10:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling POC kickoff — onsite or virtual?

Hi all — thanks for the fast coordination. A few clarifications from Nebula: 

- We prefer Aug 25 13:00–17:00 PT if it lets more of our analytics team join remotely in the afternoon. If Lab 2 is already reserved Aug 24, can we switch to Aug 25?
- Recording: yes, we consent to Redwood recording the session provided the recording is stored for no more than 90 days and access is restricted to Nebula and Redwood staff listed in the guest list. We’ll sign the consent form.
- Visitor list: attaching a preliminary roster. Note: two contractors will be onsite — they require visitor badges and will bring government IDs.

One ask about the load test: can you run the throughput test at a capped token rate (we prefer not to exceed 350 tokens/sec for the first run to mirror our production throttling)? Also can you confirm the model variant you’ll use for the load run?

Thanks,
Kate Lin
Engineering Manager, Analytics | Nebula Retail
kate.lin@nebularetail.com

Attachments: nebula_roster_aug25.xlsx (sent)

Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Final: POC kickoff confirmed for Aug 25 13:00–17:00 PT — agenda & next steps

Thanks everyone — confirming final plan and next steps below.

Final schedule (confirmed):
- Date/time: Wed, Aug 25, 2027 — 13:00–17:00 PT (Redwood Lab 2, San Francisco). We will also provide a dial-in and a Teams link for remote attendees.
- Onsite access: Nebula to send final visitor list by Mon, Aug 23 12:00 PM PT to security@redwoodinference.com (names in attached visitor_badge_form.pdf).
- AV & recording: Pre-check at 12:30 PT the day of; recording will be uploaded to the restricted Drive folder and retained for 60 days per Nebula consent.
- Load test: We will run the cap-limited throughput run at 350 tokens/sec for the first iteration and will note any tail-latency spikes. Model variant for the test: redwood-open-7B-quant-v3 (we’ll include a link to the model spec in the runbook).
- Deliverables: post-session runbook (Dev), recording link (ops), sanitized logs and perf summary (Redwood SRE).

Attachments (for Nebula): room_layout.pdf, AV_checklist.xlsx, visitor_badge_form.pdf, proposed_agenda_v2.docx, loadtest_runbook_v1.md

Please confirm the visitor list and approve the recording retention (reply-all with "approved"). Once approved, I’ll send a calendar invite with the final dial-in and security instructions.

Looking forward to it — we’ll keep the agenda tight and the runbook reproducible.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
